tool.description: Ask the KB a question or search it. Default intent-v1 ranking returns five one-line decision cards (requirements and ADRs, ranked by words and, with a search-hints plugin, by meaning), up to seven more decisions related by meaning, and an answer layer: the current requirements that govern the topic with their statement and recorded reason (why), what must stay true (linked facts), the deciding ADRs and what verifies it (scenarios, tests). A weak answer names no governing requirement and lists the words no card holds. Pass type to search scenarios, tests, facts or symbols. Use before changing behavior, then kb_query for exact follow-up. No mutation side effects.

answer.description: Intent-v1, first page: when true (default), include the answer layer of governing requirements and their evidence.

fields.description: 'summary': metadata, snippet (bare rows for entities the answer quotes); 'full': bodies, graph paths, fact queries.

hints.description: Intent-v1: true (default) fuses a search-hints plugin's meaning ranking and lists up to seven related decisions.

kb.description: Optional KB dependency name from .kb/dependencies.json to read, at its pinned commit, instead of this project's KB.

limit.description: Optional max rows after ranking. Default: 5 decision cards, or 10 rows of another type; page with offset for more.

minScore.description: Intent-v1 threshold, 0 to 1, for scenario, test, fact or symbol rows; low-confidence queries abstain.

query.description: Free-text query for metadata and markdown body discovery. Example: 'OAuth login flow'.

rankingMode.description: Optional ranking mode: intent-v1 (default, question-aware) or legacy (older lexical ranking).

semanticFacets.description: Optional host-agent interpretations Kibi adds to the question's words and uses as facets.

sourceLocations.description: Optional changed-code locations. Results are matched to source-linked symbols/entities and include source evidence.

type.description: Optional entity type filter to narrow discovery. Example: 'req'.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

tool.name: kb_search
